title: Which Hogwarts house is the most pure-blood?

voiceover.text: Which Hogwarts house is the most pure-blood?
We took a hundred and forty main characters from the Harry Potter Wiki.
Only sixty-five have a clear blood status.
Drop those without a house, and fifty-six are left.
Count the pure-bloods, and Gryffindor wins, with fourteen.
But look at the share. Slytherin leads, sixty-nine percent to fifty-four.
And nine of Gryffindor's fourteen are Weasleys.
Ravenclaw doesn't have a single confirmed pure-blood.
Slytherin has no Muggle-borns at all. But it does have five half-bloods.
One of them is Tom Riddle. Lord Voldemort.
We counted this on Querious, with one short SQL query.
Group it your way, then download the result, or connect it to your own AI and tools.
Just remember: that's fifty-six characters out of a hundred and forty, from a fan wiki.
The data is open. The question is yours.
